mood.label: Drowsy Starlight Care
mood.summary: A tender bedtime journey that grows slower and sleepier with each gentle rescue.

storyteller.quirk: Pauses softly whenever a rescued star settles.

kid_younger.quirk: Wonders whether each star needs a little pillow.

art.line: Feathered print silhouettes and delicate white contour marks.
art.lighting: Diffuse moonlight and soft pearl-white star halos.
art.composition: Spacious skies, one clear rescue per spread, rounded readable figures, increasingly restful horizontal arrangements.
art.style_prompt_prefix: Handcrafted cyanotype bedtime picture-book print, midnight blue ground, lilac and dusty rose hand-tinting, luminous white stars, soft print textures, tiny friendly guardian in a glowing blanket cape.

qa.intro_hook: Can you spot the sleepy star? Point, whisper, or just listen.
qa.outro_hook: Shall we rest our hands and whisper goodnight to our little guardian?

kid_notes.kid_older: Offer simple comfort choices; welcome every caring answer.
kid_notes.kid_younger: Invite pointing or a tiny tuck-in gesture; silent participation is welcome.

sound.music_direction: Sparse, soft celesta over a warm pad; no percussion or swells. Keep cues delicate and ambience beneath voices; fade gradually to silence at bedtime.

rationale: Cyanotype prints and a blue–lilac–rose palette distinguish this from felt applique. A hushed bedtime mood and optional noticing and tuck-in games support gentle care and a peaceful ending.
